instruction.name: x86mtflag
instruction.description: Write selected x86 flags in EFLAGS from the corresponding bit positions in rd, as determined by mask. Only EFLAGS is modified.

operands.name: rd
operands.description: source bits for the selected flags

operands.name: mask
operands.description: flag-selection mask (0x3f selects CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, OF)

experiments.name: extra x86mfflag calibration
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: 1 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86mtflag $r4, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r5, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r6, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r7, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r8, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r9, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r10, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r11, 0x3f
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0x3f
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0x3f' --asm 'x86mtflag $r4, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r5, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r6, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r7, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r8, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r9, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r10, 0x3f; x86mtflag $r11, 0x3f'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
